content: Hello! How can I assist you with your account today?
Hi, I forgot my password and need to reset it to access my dashboard.
No problem. Please go to the login page and click on the 'Forgot Password?' link just below the password field.
I see it. After I click, it asks for my username or email. Which one should I use?
You can enter either your employee email address or your assigned username—whichever you prefer.
Okay, I entered my email address and submitted. Now it's asking me to check my inbox for a verification code.
Perfect. Look for an email from 'support@company.com' and enter the six-digit code it provides into the field on your screen.
I got the email and entered the code. Now I can create a new password.
Great! Make sure your new password is at least 8 characters long and contains a mix of letters and numbers. Once you've chosen one, click 'Reset Password' to complete the process.
All done. I was able to log in with my new password. Thank you for your help!
